geeklist.title: Raising money for my 50th: A Canadian auction of games that are out of print, deluxe-ified, or are otherwise awesome, with in-person pick up in southern Ontario
geeklist.description:
[COLOR=#3300CC][size=18][b]I'M GETTING OLD[/b][/size][/COLOR]
:goldencamel: I'm turning 50 next Spring and wanted to treat myself to something nice, so I decided I'd like to upgrade my current computer (a 13 year old Microsoft Surface Pro 1) by building my own PC. Unfortunately as a single dad on a disability income I don't have the money for that, but my wonderful boys said I could buy them fewer things for Christmas as well as selling off a bunch of our games in order to allow me this gift. The more money I raise from this auction, the less I'll have to cut back from my boys' Christmas!
:goldencamel: All these games are [b][color=#ff0000]complete[/color][/b] and are coming from a smoke-free, vape-free, pet-free home
[COLOR=#3300CC][size=18][b]AUCTION END[/b][/size][/COLOR]
:goldencamel: The auction will end on [COLOR=#CC0000][b]Monday December 8[/b][/COLOR] at an unspecified time (in order to avoid sniping and prevent any advantages for those who are in different time zones, at work, etc.).
:goldencamel: I will contact the winning bidders soon after the auction end.
[COLOR=#3300CC][size=18][b]SHIPPING[/b][/size][/COLOR]
:goldencamel: I will ship to any [b][color=#ff0000]Canadian address[/color][/b] if the auction winner pays for shipping (except for items 33, 34, and 35, which are in-person pick up only).
:goldencamel: Items will be shipped from area code N3C 4L5. Shipping costs these days are nuts, so I signed up at NetParcel.com to hopefully get you the best deals I can. For a game the size of Ticket to Ride that is packaged in a box measuring 15" X 15" X 10" and weighing 3lbs, you can expect to pay $25+ Canadian for shipping. Any of the larger/heavier items in this auction will cost considerably more than that to ship, so be aware of that! (Multiple items can be combined for a cheaper total shipping cost.)
[COLOR=#3300CC][size=18][b]IN-PERSON PICK UP[/b][/size][/COLOR]
:goldencamel: Items that you win can be picked up in person at Josh's house in Hespeler, [b][color=#ff0000]Cambridge[/color][/b], 2 minutes from Highway 401 and Townline Road. We can arrange a time when it's most convenient for you to swing by.
:goldencamel: On Thursday December 11 I'll be in [b][color=#ff0000]Toronto[/color][/b] for a concert at Lee's Palace at Bathurst & Bloor (near Snakes & Lattes Annex) at approximately 7:00 PM, so that would be an opportunity for Toronto-area auction winners to avoid shipping.
:goldencamel: On Sunday December 28 I'll be in [b][color=#ff0000]London[/color][/b] in the early afternoon, so that would be an opportunity for London-area auction winners to avoid shipping.
[COLOR=#3300CC][size=18][b]BIDDING AND PAYMENT[/b][/size][/COLOR]
:goldencamel: All bids are in [COLOR=#CC0000][b]Canadian[/b][/COLOR] dollars.
:goldencamel: Please bid in minimum increments of $1.
:goldencamel: I will accept cash when you pick up the games, or PayPal if you are having them shipped.
[COLOR=#3300CC][size=18][b]PAYING MY DUES[/b][/size][/COLOR]
:goldencamel: After the auction I will send a lump sum payment to BGG for their commission based on the amount of money raised.
Thanks for checking out my auction, and happy bidding!
:tankard::meeple:
-Josh

item.body:
[b][color=#7300ff]This ABSOLUTELY MASSIVE fantasy campaign game is a fitting start to my efforts to raise money for my 50th since I certainly find myself [i]moaning[/i] a lot more as I [i]age[/i]... [i]Agemonia[/i]...[/color][/b] :geek_zombie:
[b][color=#ff0000]Edition:[/color][/b] This is the [b]SUNDROP EDITION[/b] of the 2025 English edition, second printing, that I purchased for a total of [b]$233 Canadian + shipping[/b] through the "[b]Agemonia Reprint + New Heroes![/b]" Kickstarter campaign: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/lautapelitfi/agemonia-reprint-new-heroes/description
I have reset all the components so that it is ready to begin a new campaign.
Though this game is GIGANTIC, it is well-organized in specially-made trays: [imageid=9257014 medium]
Let's start removing those trays bit by bit and see what's in the box...
[imageid=9257007 medium] [imageid=9257008 medium] [imageid=9257009 medium] [imageid=9257010 medium] [imageid=9257011 medium] [imageid=9257012 medium]
[b][color=#ff0000]Condition:[/color][/b] Like new (purchased new, played twice), with just some very minor rule book wear.
[b][color=#0000ff]SPECIAL EXTRAS:[/color][/b]
🌟 I went through ALL the errors that had been discovered in this edition of the game as of last April and printed and/or created stickers with corrected/clarified text to put in the rule books, on game cards, and anywhere else that needed to be corrected, so that there would be totally smooth, confusion-free game play! A couple of examples:
[imageid=8837999 medium] [imageid=8838002 medium]
🌟 I added a binder of printed rule reminders, enemy movement and attack clarifications, and errata/FAQs: [imageid=9257006 medium]
🌟 I printed a double-sided comprehensive rules summary: [imageid=9257013 medium]
🌟 Even within the nicely organized trays, I sorted and bagged similar components to make the huge amount of components a breeze to find during game play.
[b][color=#ff0000]Minimum bid:[/color][/b] $175 Canadian (in comparison to the total of $233 Canadian + shipping that I paid for the game through Kickstarter!)
[b][color=#ff0000]Shipping note:[/color][/b] This game is an absolute unit - it measures 18"/46cm length X 12 3/4"/32cm width X 8 1/2"/22cm height, and according to my bathroom scale, weighs 20lbs! As such, it will cost at least $35 to ship, and possibly much more.
[ImageID=9257278 medium] [i]Set up for the first scenario - My photo[/i]

[size=18][b][i][color=#ff0000]CURR[/color][color=#ff5100]ENTLY[/color] [color=#edba02]UNAVA[/color][color=#13aa18]ILABLE [/color][color=#0008ff]IN CA[/color][color=#9708f7]NADA![/color][/i][/b][/size]
[b][color=#7300ff]I had a lot of fun playing this WILDLY OVERPRODUCED cooperative game based around programmed actions with my 2 little minions![/color][/b]
[b][color=#ff0000]Edition:[/color][/b] This is the 2016 English first edition.
I have reset all the components so that it is ready to begin a new campaign.
Seriously, the production of this game is absolutely bonkers! The axe head of that boss minion standing behind the already BIG and chunky hero figures is 5"/12.5cm above the ground! [imageid=9257020 medium]
Just like with the previous auction item, though this game is GIGANTIC, it is well-organized in specially-made trays. Once again, let's start removing those trays bit by bit and see what's in the box...
[imageid=9257015 medium] [imageid=9257016 medium] [imageid=9257017 medium] [imageid=9257018 medium] [imageid=9257019 medium]
[b][color=#ff0000]Condition:[/color][/b] The box and rule book have minor wear, everything else is in excellent condition.
[b][color=#0000ff]SPECIAL EXTRAS:[/color][/b]
🌟 I printed an FAQ document.
[b][color=#ff0000]Minimum bid:[/color][/b] $95 Canadian
[b][color=#ff0000]Shipping note:[/color][/b] Here, again, is an absolute unit of a game - it measures 20"/51cm length X 13 1/2"/34cm width X 5"/12.5cm height, and according to my bathroom scale, weighs 13lbs! As such, it will cost at least $35 to ship, and possibly more.
[ImageID=3183967 medium] [i]Photo by @RiotAstryx[/i]

[size=18][b][i][color=#ff0000]CURR[/color][color=#ff5100]ENTLY[/color] [color=#edba02]UNAVA[/color][color=#13aa18]ILABLE [/color][color=#0008ff]IN CA[/color][color=#9708f7]NADA![/color][/i][/b][/size]
[b][color=#7300ff]Winter is coming! So make sure this [b][i]game[/i][/b] gets [b][i]"throne"[/i][/b] into your collection to keep you having fun through these long, dreary months! I've been a huge fan of the [family=50][/family] series of games ever since first owning/playing [thing=551][/thing] in 1999, and for my money, Battles of Westeros is the very best of the bunch. Honestly, this game has been amongst my Top 10 favourite games of all time for many years and it's not easy to let go, but I've had my fun with it and am ready to move it on to be enjoyed by someone else.[/b][/color]
[b][color=#ff0000]Edition:[/color][/b] The base game is the 2010 English edition, but included in this bundle is... wait for it... literally [i]EVERYTHING[/i] available for this game series:
[thing=123847][/thing] [imageid=1323906 medium]
[thing=71493][/thing] [imageid=883238 medium]
[thing=77849][/thing] [imageid=883240 medium]
[thing=88926][/thing] [imageid=991170 medium]
[thing=103515][/thing] [imageid=1077791 medium]
[thing=93038][/thing] [imageid=991213 medium]
[thing=113583][/thing] [imageid=1414046 medium]
Everything is packed up in the base game box and the Baratheon expansion box: [imageid=9255970 medium]
[b][color=#ff0000]Condition:[/color][/b] The box and rule books have minor wear, everything else is in very good condition.
[b][color=#0000ff]SPECIAL EXTRAS:[/color][/b]
🌟 I gave all 32 Commander figures a monochromatic paint job in order to bring out their details. The colours were chosen based on their families, and the edges of the bases were also painted in the matching colours. I then added 4 name stickers to every base so that you could easily identify the Commanders from every angle. Additionally, I painted the top of the flag poles to match the colour of the flags. [ImageID=9255976 medium] [imageid=9255974 medium] [imageid=9255968 medium] [imageid=9255975 medium] [imageid=9255971 medium] [imageid=9255978 medium]
🌟 I glued all of the hundreds of figures onto their bases, then I took the 29 different figure types, sorted them into separate bags, and created a label for each bag showing the figure name, an image of the figure, how many total figures are in the bag, and the maximum number of units that can be created with that number of figures: [imageid=9255967 medium]
🌟 In order to create a more 3D effect on the game board I purchased 16 wooden hexes matching the game board's hex size, painted them, created stickers using the game's image of a Hill hex, and stuck the image of the Hill onto the hexes. I also acquired 8 wooden bridges to replace the cardboard bridge tiles, and I printed a "fire spread direction" map overlay: [imageid=9255973 medium]
🌟 I got some glass tokens to replace the tiny cardboard tokens for the Round track and the Morale track: [imageid=9255972 medium]
🌟 I included a binder of dozens of printed pages including rules references, errata, FAQs, an entirely rewritten rule book called "Complete and Corrected Rulebook" that was a labour of love by the game's fans because the original game's rule book left a lot to be desired, some optional "Advanced Variant" rules, and 3 official bonus scenarios: [imageid=9255969 medium]
🌟 Custom storage solutions: [imageid=9255977 medium]
🌟 A bunch of player reference sheets, plus a couple of reference cards for my personal variant rules for Ranged units.
[b][color=#ff0000]Minimum bid:[/color][/b] $95 Canadian
[b][color=#ff0000]Shipping note:[/color][/b] The 2 large boxes stacked together measure 12"/30cm length X 12"/30cm width X 8 1/2"/21.5cm height, and according to my bathroom scale, weighs 14lbs! As such, it will cost at least $35 to ship, and possibly much more.
[imageid=9257699 medium] [i][My photo - Trees not included!][/i]

[size=18][b]In the case of several of these expansions: [i][color=#ff0000]CURR[/color][color=#ff5100]ENTLY[/color] [color=#edba02]UNAVA[/color][color=#13aa18]ILABLE [/color][color=#0008ff]IN CA[/color][color=#9708f7]NADA![/color][/i][/b][/size]
[b][color=#7300ff]"Dad, are we pyromaniacs?" "Yes, we arson."
This game could only ever be cooperative, because could you imagine shoving aside your fellow firefighters in an effort to save the most victims?[/color][/b]
[b][color=#ff0000]Edition:[/color][/b] The base game is the 2011 English first edition with firefighter figures, and also included are:
[thing=126954][/thing] [imageid=2625250 medium]
[thing=110139][/thing] [imageid=1121985 medium]

All of this is contained within the base game box and the Extreme Danger expansion box.
[b][color=#ff0000]Condition:[/color][/b] The boxes and rule books have minor wear, everything else is in very good condition.
[b][color=#0000ff]SPECIAL EXTRAS:[/color][/b]
🌟 All 14 firefighter figures (including the rescue dog!) are painted: [imageid=9255989 medium]
🌟 The cardboard tokens for the fire truck and the ambulance have been replaced with diecast trucks: [imageid=9255988 medium]
🌟 The cardboard tokens for fire, smoke, and hot spots have been replaced with 3D acrylic tokens: [imageid=9255984 medium]
🌟 Lots of printed player reference sheets: [imageid=9255985 medium]
🌟 A bonus scenario: [imageid=9255986 medium]
🌟 As someone who worked as a Paramedic for 16 years [microbadge=24470], I never liked that people could die horrible fiery deaths in this game and players could still achieve a victory, so I created a "Punishing Death Variant": [imageid=9255987 medium]
[b][color=#ff0000]Minimum bid:[/color][/b] $95 Canadian
[ImageID=2248090 medium] [i]Photo by @jsper[/i]

[size=18][b][i][color=#ff0000]CURR[/color][color=#ff5100]ENTLY[/color] [color=#edba02]UNAVA[/color][color=#13aa18]ILABLE [/color][color=#0008ff]IN CA[/color][color=#9708f7]NADA![/color][/i][/b][/size]
[b][color=#7300ff]Oh aye, t'would be a grrrea-it gam ta play wi' yer bonny wee mates p'raps! Och, yer sayin' ya doesnae underston me, noo? Well, I'll gi' ye somethin' you might ken: lush grassland, sparkling lochs, and rolling hills that roll e'en more'n our "R"s, all ta be settled and turned inta resources ta mak' whisky 'n' wool 'n' so many lovely goods! And sheep! Och aye, sheep for daaaaays, man!! Because always remember, eff ett isnae Scottish ett's crrrrrrap![/color][/b]
[b][color=#ff0000]Edition:[/color][/b] This is the 2025 English edition with both the [thing=216132][/thing] base game and the [thing=391913][/thing] expansion all in 1 box, that I purchased for a total of [b]$116 Canadian + shipping[/b] through the "Clans of Caledonia: Industria" Kickstarter campaign: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/karma-games/clans-of-caledonia-industria/description
And yes, this is yet another brick of a game whose many components are stored in lovely custom trays: [imageid=9256988 medium]
[b][color=#ff0000]Condition:[/color][/b] Like new (purchased new, played once), with just some very minor reading wear in the rule book.
[b][color=#0000ff]SPECIAL EXTRAS:[/color][/b]
🌟 I printed 4 player reference sheets, a rules summary sheet, and pages of quick reference sheets for Scoring tiles, Port tiles, Milestones, Delivery Bonuses, and the Clans' special abilities: [imageid=9256987 medium]
[b][color=#ff0000]Minimum bid:[/color][/b] $85 Canadian
[b][color=#ff0000]Shipping note:[/color][/b] This game is heavier than average!
[ImageID=6145048 medium] [i]Photo by @Deep Chunk[/i]

[b][color=#7300ff]Don't worry, M:TG has already corrupted you, so you don't need to worry about any further corruption from owning the One Ring![/color][/b]
[b][color=#ff0000]Edition:[/color][/b] This is for the M:TG card "The One Ring" that is pictured here, which I pulled from a draft booster pack.
[b][color=#ff0000]Condition:[/color][/b] Like new, as pulled from the pack. I just put this card straight back into the packaging after I removed the other cards and I haven't touched it since.
[ImageID=8504955 medium] [i]My photo[/i]
[b][color=#ff0000]Minimum bid:[/color][/b] $75 Canadian (According to MTGgoldfish.com, the current maximum value of the card is $89.90 USD = $125.69 Canadian)

[b][color=#7300ff]I would like to offer you not just A Gest of Robin Hood, but also some jests of Robin Hood:
What was Robin Hood's favourite font? Sans-sheriff.
What disease finally ended up being Robin Hood's undoing? Menintightis.
Robin Hood fought long and hard to keep wealthy clergy out of Sherwood, but finally his trusty yew bow broke and Tuck was able to slip past him and join the Merry Men. Remember, only yew can prevent forest friars!
In this 2-player asymmetrical game, both Robin Hood and the Sheriff have sneaky stuff going on![/color][/b]
[b][color=#ff0000]Edition:[/color][/b] This is the 2024 English edition, first printing.
[b][color=#ff0000]Condition:[/color][/b] Excellent (purchased new and played twice), with only minor rule book reading wear.
[b][color=#0000ff]SPECIAL EXTRAS:[/color][/b]
🌟 Printed errata & FAQs
🌟 I created detailed player aids for the Robin Hood and the Sheriff player: [imageid=9048331 medium]
🌟 I added stickers to the player screens in the "redeployment" section to add more details in order to avoid having to reference the rule book: [imageid=9255964 medium]
🌟 Printed official rules for playing solo as both sides, and for adding Heroic and Villainous Personas
[b][color=#ff0000]Minimum bid:[/color][/b] $45 Canadian
[imageid=8503801 medium] [i]Photo by @The Innocent[/i]

[size=18][b][i][color=#ff0000]CURR[/color][color=#ff5100]ENTLY[/color] [color=#edba02]UNAVA[/color][color=#13aa18]ILABLE [/color][color=#0008ff]IN CA[/color][color=#9708f7]NADA![/color][/i][/b][/size]
[b][color=#7300ff]This is the ULTIMATE pirate game if you have a full day to play and friends who can handle a lot of rules! But enough of the chit-chat Me Hearties - I've got a leg to peg, an eye patch to snatch, a ship to equip, a village to pillage, a governor's daughter to slaughter, a cup o' rum to put in me tum, some Pieces of Eight to appropriate, and a guy with a black spot that needs to be shot. Arrrr!![/color][/b] 🏴‍☠️
[b][color=#ff0000]Edition:[/color][/b] The base game is the 2010 English first edition. Also included is: [thing=161167][/thing] [imageid=2247789 medium]
All components are stored within the base game box.
[b][color=#ff0000]Condition:[/color][/b] The box and rule books have minor wear. I bought the expansion new but never got a chance to play it. 🙁 All other components are in very good condition.
[b][color=#0000ff]SPECIAL EXTRAS:[/color][/b]

🌟 A printed booklet with my own variant rules, plus rules for 2 expansions I created called "Ports & Forts" and "Mobile Merchants".
🌟 19 Fort tokens with removable nation flags that I made for my "Ports & Forts" variant, but that could also be used to mark which nation currently controls each city: [imageid=1041675 medium]
🌟 Extra nation and pirate flags printed onto label paper: [imageid=9256002 medium]
🌟 Custom components for all the fan-made expansion content: [imageid=9256001 medium]
🌟 20 custom-made Captain cards to add to the 34 official ones, creating a lot more options for players to try: [imageid=9256000 medium]
🌟 Custom-made board for the Event and Mission cards: [imageid=9255997 medium]
🌟 I created 4 base game rules reference booklets, 1 for each nation: [imageid=9255998 medium] [imageid=9255999 medium]
🌟 Printed comprehensive rules summaries for the base game, and a combat flow chart: [imageid=9256003 medium]
🌟 I glued the 4 player sloops and the pirate sloop onto blue wooden discs so the @#$%ing things wouldn't keep tipping over all the time! [imageid=1041628 medium]

🌟 Printed player aids
🌟 FAQ document
[b][color=#ff0000]Minimum bid:[/color][/b] $20 Canadian
[ImageID=4245201 medium] [i]Image by @FunStorm[/i]

[size=18][b][i][color=#ff0000]CURR[/color][color=#ff5100]ENTLY[/color] [color=#edba02]UNAVA[/color][color=#13aa18]ILABLE [/color][color=#0008ff]IN CA[/color][color=#9708f7]NADA![/color][/i][/b][/size]
[b][color=#7300ff]This game is sort of like if the designer started with the general feeling of Craps (the dice-based gambling game, not the feeling my Crohn's gives me), added a theme of attempting to sail goods into a harbour under the noses of greedy pirates, and added an element of secretly trying to push up the values of certain goods in the market.[/color][/b]
[b][color=#ff0000]Edition:[/color][/b] This is the 2005 Polish edition (with a printed English rule book - all other components are language independent), that still had [i]way[/i] better components (wooden boats and the best plastic coins I've seen in any board game, ever) than the cardboard garbage of the 2014 reprint! How did I end up with a Polish game? No idea - I've owned and enjoyed this game for many years and I don't recall where I originally picked it up!
[b][color=#ff0000]Condition:[/color][/b] This game doesn't have the original rule book (it would have been in Polish in this edition!), but I do have a printed English rule book. The box has minor wear, but everything else is in very good condition.
[b][color=#0000ff]SPECIAL EXTRAS:[/color][/b]
🌟 Like I said above, this game has the best plastic coins I've ever seen in a game. However I made the coins even better by spray painting them in metallic colours to make them really shine: [imageid=1383052 medium] [imageid=1383051 medium]
🌟 I made some very simple player screens so that players could more easily hide which goods cards they were collecting and how much money they had remaining.
🌟 Printed FAQs document.
🌟 Printed 2-player variant rules.
🌟 I created a custom variant to switch up the Harbour Master auction and spread out the fun a little bit from round to round (and added extra meeples for each player so that they could mark which actions were chosen by each player). Of course anyone who wishes to simply play vanilla Manila can continue to do so without any problems!
[b][color=#ff0000]Minimum bid:[/color][/b] $20 Canadian
[ImageID=75947 medium] [i]Photo by @fungry[/i]

[size=18][b][i][color=#ff0000]CURR[/color][color=#ff5100]ENTLY[/color] [color=#edba02]UNAVA[/color][color=#13aa18]ILABLE [/color][color=#0008ff]IN CA[/color][color=#9708f7]NADA![/color][/i][/b][/size]
[b][color=#7300ff]Don't give thith game a myth if you love loadth of mythological creatureth![/color][/b]
[b][color=#ff0000]Edition:[/color][/b] This is the 2003 English edition. It comes with 100 Norse figures in 2 player colours... [imageid=9255950 medium] ...96 Egyptian figures in 2 player colours... [imageid=9255948 medium] ...and 94 Greek figures in 2 player colours... [imageid=9255949 medium] ...for a total of 290 figures of ancient warriors, heroes, and mythological creatures!
[b][color=#ff0000]Condition:[/color][/b] The box and rule book have minor wear, everything else is in very good condition. But just to note, all the player boards do have a bit of an unfortunate natural warp to them: [imageid=9255945 medium]
[b][color=#0000ff]SPECIAL EXTRAS:[/color][/b]
🌟 So, this game clearly comes with loads of amazing minis, but the Building tiles were the most boring things ever! (They're the plain yellow tiles in the images below.) To rectify this crime against board game production, I created 138 custom tiles using artwork from the Age of Mythology video game so that I could replace the original Building tiles with 2 complete sets of nation-specific buildings for each of the 3 different nations in the game: [imageid=9255946 medium] [imageid=9255947 medium]
🌟 Here's the next problem with the original game: the combat rules were downright terrible! So I created custom rules for a "Battle Line" variant, as well as a custom board to duke it out on: [imageid=9255944 medium]
🌟 I created 16 (4 sets of 4) "Age" reference stands for players to mark which Age they were currently in and keep track of what changes as a result: [imageid=9255943 medium]
🌟 3 very detailed, double-sided player aids (1 for each nation): [imageid=9255951 medium] [imageid=9255952 medium]
🌟 3 double-sided combat/unit reference sheets (1 for each nation): [imageid=9255953 medium] [imageid=9255954 medium]
[b][color=#ff0000]Minimum bid:[/color][/b] $20 Canadian
[ImageID=148278 medium] [i]Photo by @sandysidamo[/i]

item.objectname: Agricola: All Creatures Big and Small
item.body:
[b][color=#7300ff](They're mainly small creatures, and it's not ALL of them.) Please don't take away my Board Gamer Card, but I didn't like the original [thing=31260][/thing]. However this wee little worker placement game that distills the farming experience down to only its most awesome and least manure-covered elements is absolutely delightful! Best of all, nobody needs to be fed![/color][/b]
[b][color=#ff0000]Edition:[/color][/b] This is the 2012 English first edition. Also included with this are: [thing=130752][/thing] [imageid=1451726 medium] [thing=145355][/thing] [imageid=1723707 medium]
(So it's as if you're getting the [thing=255262][/thing], except you're getting everything in the original very small base game box!)
[b][color=#ff0000]Condition:[/color][/b] The box and rule book have minor wear, everything else is in excellent condition.
[b][color=#0000ff]SPECIAL EXTRAS:[/color][/b]
🌟 The larger round discs that represented the players' farmers have been replaced with meeples.
🌟 The smaller round discs that represented the resources have been replaced with these clay resources: [imageid=9255937 medium]
🌟 I created custom score sheets, laminated them, and included dry erase markers for much easier end-game point tallying: [imageid=9255938 medium]
🌟 I created a custom Building reference sheet (with all the buildings from the base game and both expansions) for each player and added some wooden cubes to put next to the buildings on the reference sheet that are in play for the current game: [imageid=9255936 medium]
[b][color=#ff0000]Minimum bid:[/color][/b] $20 Canadian
[ImageID=2996632 medium] [i]Photo by @AMJC[/i]

I've labelled the areas of the board that keep the Recruitment and Threat tiles with appropriate labels because how those tiles move around is the one very confusing aspect of this otherwise very simple game: [imageid=9255995 medium]

[b][color=#0000ff]SPECIAL EXTRAS:[/color][/b]
🌟 I printed some custom player aids.
[b][color=#ff0000]Minimum bid:[/color][/b] $15 Canadian
[ImageID=5230378 medium] [i]Photo by @henk.rolleman[/i]

item.objectname: The Lord of the Rings: Adventure to Mount Doom
item.body:
[b][color=#7300ff]The [i]real[/i] adventure was the hobbits we corrupted along the way in this cooperative game of dice and card manipulation.[/color][/b]
[b][color=#ff0000]Edition:[/color][/b] This is the 2023 English edition.
[b][color=#ff0000]Condition:[/color][/b] Acquired new and played once. The box has a bit of very minor dishing on the back of 1 corner and the rule book has very minor reading wear, but everything else is in excellent condition.
[b][color=#0000ff]SPECIAL EXTRAS:[/color][/b]
🌟 I printed some variant rules that spice up the game by adding special abilities for each of the members of the Fellowship.
[b][color=#ff0000]Minimum bid:[/color][/b] $10 Canadian
[ImageID=7459769 medium] [i]Photo by @Puma85[/i]

[size=18][b][i][color=#ff0000]CURR[/color][color=#ff5100]ENTLY[/color] [color=#edba02]UNAVA[/color][color=#13aa18]ILABLE [/color][color=#0008ff]IN CA[/color][color=#9708f7]NADA![/color][/i][/b][/size]
[b][color=#7300ff]Don't worry, this game isn't out of your league - it's very straight-forward "pick up and deliver" with tech upgrades for your spaceship... [i]in spaaaaaaaaaace![/i][/color][/b]
[b][color=#ff0000]Edition:[/color][/b] This is the 2010 English edition.
[b][color=#ff0000]Condition:[/color][/b] Mostly very good, although the box has a bit of wear (but it's intact and has no split corners/edges).
[b][color=#0000ff]SPECIAL EXTRAS:[/color][/b]
🌟 Includes custom game board, custom player boards, custom score track, custom turn summary card, and custom glass tokens for players to track their various actions: [imageid=9256024 medium]
🌟 Printed rules and components for the designer-created 3 player expansion and the designer-created "Secrets of the Cosmic League" expansion (including blank cards to allow you to come up with your own cards): [imageid=7774577 medium]
🌟 Printed document of FAQs
[b][color=#ff0000]Minimum bid:[/color][/b] $10 Canadian
[ImageID=9256025 medium] [i]My photo[/i]

[b][color=#7300ff]If you don't think this little push-your-luck card game isn't flippin' great, just look at all the awards it has won and all the people who have been raving about it! (Just remember that the title of the game isn't the instruction for how to play it every time...)[/color][/b]
[b][color=#ff0000]Edition:[/color][/b] This is the 2024 English first edition.
[b][color=#ff0000]Condition:[/color][/b] Everything is in very good condition.
[b][color=#0000ff]SPECIAL EXTRAS:[/color][/b]
🌟 I printed a document of FAQs and rules edge cases.
[b][color=#ff0000]Minimum bid:[/color][/b] $5 Canadian
[ImageID=8970457 medium] [i]Photo by @lschlesser[/i]

[size=18][b][i][color=#ff0000]CURR[/color][color=#ff5100]ENTLY[/color] [color=#edba02]UNAVA[/color][color=#13aa18]ILABLE [/color][color=#0008ff]IN CA[/color][color=#9708f7]NADA![/color][/i][/b][/size]
[b][color=#7300ff]I think I'd rather ravage the hunter... :geek_tongue: This is a 2-player, asymmetric card-driven game of hidden movement where each player gets a chance to be the sneaky hidden player![/color][/b]
[b][color=#ff0000]Edition:[/color][/b] This is the 2021 English edition. Also included is: [thing=365660][/thing] [imageid=7040026 medium]
[b][color=#ff0000]Condition:[/color][/b] Purchased new, played once. Everything is in excellent condition, except the rule book has a couple of very small tears.
[b][color=#0000ff]SPECIAL EXTRAS:[/color][/b]
🌟 I created custom reference sheets to make game play a breeze: [imageid=9255990 medium]
[b][color=#ff0000]Minimum bid:[/color][/b] $5 Canadian
[ImageID=4973909 medium] [i]Photo by the game's publisher, Kolossol Games[/i]

[b][color=#7300ff]Another 2-player, asymmetrical, card-driven game of hidden sneakiness - it's almost like I have too many similarly awesome games! This one, designed by [person=34699][/person] and [person=149934][/person], is based on real WWII history when the German war ship Admiral Graf Spree sank 9 freight ships, sending almost 50,000 gross register tons to the seabed (and humanity definitely doesn't need to be throwing any more gross things into the ocean). In the game, the German player needs to remain hidden while sinking cargo ships, while the British player must hunt down and engage the Admiral Graf Spree in a victory-determining final battle![/color][/b]
[b][color=#ff0000]Edition:[/color][/b] This is the spicy 2023 Salt & Pepper English edition
All of the game's cards are sleeved!
[b][color=#ff0000]Condition:[/color][/b] Purchased new, played once. Everything is in excellent condition.
[b][color=#0000ff]SPECIAL EXTRAS:[/color][/b]
🌟 I printed a double-sided reference sheet for each player: [imageid=9256033 medium] [imageid=9256032 medium]
[b][color=#ff0000]Minimum bid:[/color][/b] $5 Canadian
[ImageID=8188350 medium] [i]Photo by @Jean_Leviathan[/i]

[b][color=#7300ff]When are we getting the sequel, "Guys With Ties Eating Fries and Pies: A Business Lunch Story"? More 2 player card based sneaky bluffing and deduction - do I have a problem?? (And while I'm asking questions, does anyone else out there have very strong childhood nostalgia for [thing=1917][/thing]?)[/color][/b]
[b][color=#ff0000]Edition:[/color][/b] This is the 2021 English/French edition.
[b][color=#ff0000]Condition:[/color][/b] Purchased new, played once. Everything is in excellent condition.
[b][color=#ff0000]Minimum bid:[/color][/b] $5 Canadian
[ImageID=5067729 medium] [i]Photo by @Schwarzsturm[/i]

[b][color=#7300ff]2-player asymmetrical sneakiness, you say? One player is the king and the king's guards - all they have to do is walk the king safely across the plaza to his castle while arresting the most suspicious-looking citizens. The other player controls the citizens, amongst whom are 3 secret assassins, who are all prowling around the alleys and on the roofs of the buildings, looking for an opportunity to dekingify themselves.[/color][/b]
[b][color=#ff0000]Edition:[/color][/b] This is the 2013 English edition. (Only the newer and more expense Deluxe Edition is currently available at Canadian retail.)
[b][color=#ff0000]Condition:[/color][/b] Everything is in very good condition.
[b][color=#0000ff]SPECIAL EXTRAS:[/color][/b]
🌟 The Citizen/Assassin cards are sleeved because it's important that they not get marked up in any way that would allow players to be able to tell them apart.
🌟 I added some glass tokens so that players could track the number of available actions they have in a round: [imageid=9256989 medium]
[b][color=#ff0000]Minimum bid:[/color][/b] $5 Canadian
[ImageID=1822485 medium] [i]Photo by @rvlieshout[/i]

[size=18][b][i][color=#ff0000]CURR[/color][color=#ff5100]ENTLY[/color] [color=#edba02]UNAVA[/color][color=#13aa18]ILABLE [/color][color=#0008ff]IN CA[/color][color=#9708f7]NADA![/color][/i][/b][/size]
[b][color=#7300ff]These gentlemen may be thieves, but the [i]real[/i] crime here is how criminally underrated this game is - I rate it 8.5/10! Here we have yet more sneakiness, bluffing, and secret identities, this time with 3-5 players. It's just too bad the game didn't do well enough to get the sequel, "Aristocrat Jaywalkers".[/color][/b]
[b][color=#ff0000]Edition:[/color][/b] This is the 2012 English/French first edition.
[b][color=#ff0000]Condition:[/color][/b] Everything is in excellent condition. (There is a small amount of highlighting in the rule book to help remember a couple of more easily forgettable rules.)
[b][color=#0000ff]SPECIAL EXTRAS:[/color][/b]
🌟 Perhaps one reason this game's rating is lower than it ought to be (in my opinion, of course) is the fact that there isn't enough incentive for players to keep their identities hidden. Well, I've solved that issue with some simple variant rules!
[b][color=#ff0000]Minimum bid:[/color][/b] $5 Canadian
[ImageID=1421245 medium] [i]Photo by @Toynan[/i]

[size=18][b][i][color=#ff0000]CURR[/color][color=#ff5100]ENTLY[/color] [color=#edba02]UNAVA[/color][color=#13aa18]ILABLE [/color][color=#0008ff]IN CA[/color][color=#9708f7]NADA![/color][/i][/b][/size]
[b][color=#7300ff]This game, which is arguably one of the best things to come out of Prohibition, is another case where the true crime is how criminally underrated it is! Prohis, which has been described as "[thing=157969][/thing]-lite", is a game of (you guessed it) sneaking and bluffing where 3-6 players are attempting to smuggle valuable contraband goods under the noses of their opponents' Inspectors with the hope that those nosy authorities will only inspect the trucks carrying the less valuable legitimate goods.[/color][/b]
[b][color=#ff0000]Edition:[/color][/b] This is the 2013 English-only first edition.
[b][color=#ff0000]Condition:[/color][/b] The box has a bit of dishing at the back, but is structurally fine. Everything else is in very good condition.
[b][color=#0000ff]SPECIAL EXTRAS:[/color][/b]
🌟 When a player has successfully delivered goods cards, they go into a face-down pile that is abstractly referred to as their "warehouse" until it's time to reveal them during the scoring phase. I thought, "Why not find some actual warehouse tokens for players to put on top of those stacks of cards?" both as a fun thematic addition and as a reminder that those cards shouldn't be touched until it's time for end-game scoring. As an added bonus, they all fit perfectly within the game box! [imageid=9256029 medium] [imageid=9256027 medium]
🌟 I created a rules reference and flow chart showing how a player's turn should play out, and printed 6 copies: [imageid=9256028 medium]
🌟 I also printed another more comprehensive rules summary.
[b][color=#ff0000]Minimum bid:[/color][/b] $5 Canadian
[ImageID=2660402 medium] [i]Photo by @The Innocent[/i]

[size=18][b][i][color=#ff0000]CURR[/color][color=#ff5100]ENTLY[/color] [color=#edba02]UNAVA[/color][color=#13aa18]ILABLE [/color][color=#0008ff]IN CA[/color][color=#9708f7]NADA![/color][/i][/b][/size]
[imageid=1243549 medium]
[b][color=#7300ff]This not-so-innocent little game of knowing people well enough to give them the gifts they'll like the best provided us with a [i]lot[/i] of laughs when we would get together with other couples for dinner and fun, back in the day when couples get-togethers were still a thing for me...[/color][/b]
[b][color=#ff0000]Edition:[/color][/b] According to BGG, there were 4 editions of this game, all released in 2010: The Orange edition, the Pink edition, the Blue edition, and the Black Taboo edition. Although I've had this for many years and my memory is hazy, what I'm pretty sure I have here is the Blue edition and the Black Taboo edition, both packed within the Black Taboo box. (Although for the sake of convenience, I have the NSFW/adult-oriented Taboo cards bagged separately within the box.)
Another fun bonus is that there are 32 blank cards so that players can make up their own gifts to include in the game!
[b][color=#ff0000]Condition:[/color][/b] Very minor wear from use, but everything is still in very good condition.
[b][color=#ff0000]Minimum bid:[/color][/b] $5 Canadian
[ImageID=979983 medium] [i]Photo by @elas[/i]

[b][color=#7300ff]It's time to stop the [i]charade[/i] and quit [i]acting[/i] like you're too serious to have a frantically hilarious good time! If you're not cry-laughing by Round 3 of the game, perhaps you need new friends, or at least another 🍷...[/color][/b]
[b][color=#ff0000]Edition:[/color][/b] This is the 2008 English first edition (pictured with the GeekList item)
[b][color=#ff0000]Condition:[/color][/b] Very minor wear from use, but everything is still in very good condition.
[b][color=#ff0000]Minimum bid:[/color][/b] $5 Canadian
[ImageID=352376 medium] [i]Photo by @Werebear[/i]

[b][color=#7300ff]Boy, do I have an amazing game to sell you! Let me combine the words HILARIOUS and IMPROV to create the perfect sales pitch for you...[/color][/b]
[b][color=#ff0000]Edition:[/color][/b] This is the 2019 English sixth edition
[b][color=#ff0000]Condition:[/color][/b] The top of the box was crunched pretty good and required some duct tape repair. The rules sheet also has a bit of wear, but the game components are in very good condition. [imageid=9256031 medium] [imageid=9256030 medium]
[b][color=#0000ff]SPECIAL EXTRAS:[/color][/b]
🌟 I put a printed copy of the rules from a similar game, [thing=114438][/thing], in the box in case I felt inspired to mix and match some mechanisms.
[b][color=#ff0000]Minimum bid:[/color][/b] $5 Canadian
[ImageID=5075760 medium] [i]Photo by @PatHayesKaufman[/i]

[b][color=#7300ff][i]Who[/i] always wins? [i]THIS[/i] Wizard!! Actually, I renamed it to "Evan Always Wins" because my older son had a real knack for winning this game, which we used to really enjoy playing when my now-teens were a bit younger. For a family-weight game, it definitely has some interesting stuff going on with role selection, set collection, pushing your luck, levelling up, and praying desperately that the Bag of Fate is good to you![/color][/b]

[b][color=#7300ff]Be the fire-breathing reptile you have always wanted to be![/color][/b]
This item is for the 160-page RPG book, "[b]Epyllion - A Dragon Epic[/b]", which is a tabletop RPG by Marissa Kelly that allows players to be young drakes in the world of Dragonia.
[imageid=9255983 medium]
"This easy-to-learn adventure game helps you tell the stories of a brave clutch of young dragons through a supportive yet simple system that promotes active listening, creativity, and cooperative play."

For 3-5 players aged 8+, with the episodic play time listed at 2-4 hours.
